cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)
project(rttopo VERSION 1.1.0 LANGUAGES C)

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 99)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# Include paths
include_directories(
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/headers
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}
)

# Generate rttopo_config.h (autotools normally generates this)
file(WRITE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/rttopo_config.h
"/* rttopo_config.h - generated by CMake */\n"
"#ifndef RTTOPO_CONFIG_H\n"
"#define RTTOPO_CONFIG_H\n\n"
"/* HAVE_ISFINITE - ohos libc has isfinite */\n"
"#define HAVE_ISFINITE 1\n\n"
"/* RTGEOM_GEOS_VERSION - GEOS 3.13.0 => 31300 */\n"
"#define RTGEOM_GEOS_VERSION 31300\n\n"
"/* LIBRTGEOM_VERSION */\n"
"#define LIBRTGEOM_VERSION \"1.1.0\"\n\n"
"/* RTGEOM_DEBUG_LEVEL - debug message level (0=disabled) */\n"
"#define RTGEOM_DEBUG_LEVEL 0\n\n"
"#endif /* RTTOPO_CONFIG_H */\n"
)

# Generate librttopo_geom.h from librttopo_geom.h.in
# Set substitution variables (autotools @VAR@ syntax)
set(SRID_MAX 999999)
set(SRID_USR_MAX 918999)
configure_file(
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/headers/librttopo_geom.h.in
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/headers/librttopo_geom.h
    @ONLY
)

# Source files (from src/Makefile.am)
set(RTTOPO_SOURCES
    src/box2d.c
    src/bytebuffer.c
    src/g_box.c
    src/g_serialized.c
    src/g_util.c
    src/measures3d.c
    src/measures.c
    src/ptarray.c
    src/rtalgorithm.c
    src/rtcircstring.c
    src/rtcollection.c
    src/rtcompound.c
    src/rtcurvepoly.c
    src/rtgeodetic.c
    src/rtgeom_api.c
    src/rtgeom.c
    src/rtgeom_debug.c
    src/rtgeom_geos.c
    src/rtgeom_geos_clean.c
    src/rtgeom_geos_node.c
    src/rtgeom_geos_split.c
    src/rtgeom_topo.c
    src/rthomogenize.c
    src/rtin_geojson.c
    src/rtin_twkb.c
    src/rtin_wkb.c
    src/rtiterator.c
    src/rtlinearreferencing.c
    src/rtline.c
    src/rtmcurve.c
    src/rtmline.c
    src/rtmpoint.c
    src/rtmpoly.c
    src/rtmsurface.c
    src/rtout_encoded_polyline.c
    src/rtout_geojson.c
    src/rtout_gml.c
    src/rtout_kml.c
    src/rtout_svg.c
    src/rtout_twkb.c
    src/rtout_wkb.c
    src/rtout_wkt.c
    src/rtout_x3d.c
    src/rtpoint.c
    src/rtpoly.c
    src/rtprint.c
    src/rtpsurface.c
    src/rtspheroid.c
    src/rtstroke.c
    src/rtt_tpsnap.c
    src/rttin.c
    src/rttree.c
    src/rttriangle.c
    src/rtutil.c
    src/stringbuffer.c
    src/varint.c
)

# Build static library (R26: system-same-name lib static)
add_library(rttopo STATIC ${RTTOPO_SOURCES})

# Math library
target_link_libraries(rttopo m)

# GEOS dependency (provided by Conan, use injected GEOS:: targets)
find_package(geos CONFIG REQUIRED)
target_link_libraries(rttopo GEOS::geos_c GEOS::geos)

# Install
include(GNUInstallDirs)
install(TARGETS rttopo
    ARCHIVE DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}
    LIBRARY DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}
)
install(FILES headers/librttopo.h
    DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}
)
install(FILES headers/librttopo_geom.h
    DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}
)
